#import file

```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

#Put in file names
BZB_60min <- read_excel("11.3_BZB_overnight_MICMaxVolFinding_cleaned.xlsx", sheet="first_1h")
BZB_90min <- read_excel("11.3_BZB_overnight_MICMaxVolFinding_cleaned.xlsx", sheet="second_1.5h")
BZB_overnight <- read_excel("11.3_BZB_overnight_MICMaxVolFinding_cleaned.xlsx", sheet="third_overnight")
#Something went wrong during the overnight measurement... So there's only 79 obs. ~13h
```

#clean and combine

```{r}
BZB_60min$"Cycle" <- as.numeric(BZB_60min$"Cycle")

BZB_90min$"Cycle" <- as.numeric(BZB_90min$"Cycle")

BZB_overnight$"Cycle" <- as.numeric(BZB_overnight$"Cycle")
```

```{r}
BZB_90min$"Cycle" <- BZB_90min$"Cycle" + 44

BZB_overnight$"Cycle" <- BZB_overnight$"Cycle" + 134
```

```{r}
BZB_90min$Time_s <- BZB_90min$Time_s + 3600

BZB_overnight$Time_s <- BZB_overnight$Time_s + 9000
```

```{r}
combined_df <- purrr::reduce(list(BZB_60min, BZB_90min, BZB_overnight), bind_rows)
```

```{r}
#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD <- combined_df %>%
pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
#change Time [s] to Time [h]
df_clean <- pivoted_OD%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(Time_s/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  select(Cycle, Time_h, Time_min, everything())
  
```

#make keys

```{r}
df_clean$well_ID_Copy <- df_clean$well_ID

df_clean<-df_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = well_ID_Copy,
    delim = "_",
    names = c("well", "bacteriocin_vol", "BZB_vol")
  )

df_clean<- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    numeric_vol = if_else(
      grepl("uLE2", bacteriocin_vol),
      as.numeric(gsub("uLE2", "", bacteriocin_vol)),
      0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    numeric_vol = if_else(
      bacteriocin_vol == "LB",
      NA_real_,
      numeric_vol
    )
  )

df_clean$numeric_vol <- factor(df_clean$numeric_vol)


df_clean<- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    BZB_trial = case_when(
      str_starts(BZB_vol, "30uL") ~ "BZB30uL",
      str_starts(BZB_vol, "50uL") ~ "BZB50uL",
      str_starts(BZB_vol, "C") ~ "Control"
    )
  ) 

df_clean<- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    reps = str_extract(BZB_vol, "[0-9]$")
  ) 
```

#calculate mean from replicates

```{r}
df_summarise <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Time_h, BZB_trial, bacteriocin_vol, numeric_vol) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    CV = sd/mean,
    log_mean = log10(mean),
    lower_error = log10(mean) - log10(mean - sd),
    upper_error = log10(mean + sd) - log10(mean))

```

#make subsets
```{r}
BZB50 <- df_clean %>%
  filter(BZB_trial == "BZB50uL")

BZB30  <- df_clean %>%
  filter(BZB_trial == "BZB30uL")

Control <- df_clean %>%
  filter(BZB_trial == "Control")
```


#plot curves

```{r}
BZB30_curve<- df_summarise |>
  filter(BZB_trial %in% c("BZB30uL", "Control")) |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = numeric_vol)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-sd, ymax = mean+sd, color = numeric_vol), width = 0.2)+
   labs(title = "BZB Overnight MICMaxVolFinding w/ E2 11.3.26",
        subtitle = "30uL BZB per well",
        y="Mean OD",
        color="E2 volume (uL/well)",
        caption="NA is the LB-only Control; 0 is the Growth Control")

BZB30_curve

#check working directory before saving!
ggsave("./Plots/BZB30uL_overnight_MICMaxVolFinding_11.3.26.png", plot = BZB30_curve, width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

##try log(mean)
```{r}
BZB30_log_curve<- df_summarise |>
```
